name: omnisense/omnidocs
description: Omnidocs: one model of a manual, whatever wrote it - Markdown, Sphinx, Doxygen, JSDoc: its versions, its pages (title, contents, headings, the file to edit), its API entries and their anchors, read through one source contract; a search index a static page searches, and the HTML conventions of symfony.com/doc (callouts, versionadded, code with captions and tabs) every format renders to.

suggest.omnidocs/markdown: A folder of Markdown files, written as symfony.com/doc writes its pages (league/commonmark)
suggest.omnidocs/sphinx: The output of Sphinx's JSON builder and its objects.inv
suggest.omnidocs/jsdoc: The JSON JSDoc explains (jsdoc -X): a JavaScript library's API
